entities.summary: Treaty signed in san francisco dictating that japan grant the united states the territorial means for it to establish a military presence in the far east and prohibited other countries without the consent of the united states to do the same. Security Treaty Between the United States and Japan is a treaty from Americas. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
